name: Uisaki Hinano
source:
[spoiler]Real name: Fujikura Hinano (藤倉 雛乃)[/spoiler]

Konoka's classmate who sees her as a rival for some reason. She is a fan of Chupa Chups and always carries them in her pocket. Despite occasionally wearing a maid outfit for her job, she speaks with an elegant oujo-sama manner. With an impressive understanding of computers, she is tech-savvy and effortlessly navigates the AR realm.
